sourceFingerprint.scope: H4a executable, configuration, and generated schema artifacts at the H4a rerun; mutable planning documents are excluded.

limits: All domain results use a disposable in-memory SurrealDB 3.2.0 profile; no populated production migration is proven.
Selected versions are immutable typed source facts. They are not automatically looked up by tax label or date; a source changes version only through an explicit parent edit.
H4a has issue-date sales recognition and parent-local pre-tax line amounts only; aggregate, compound, purchase-rule, withholding, offset and statutory compliance behavior are outside this packet.
Rules are protected from deletion while a managed tax child refers to them; privileged administrative database access remains trusted outside the normal client boundary.
The probe checks fixed-amount precision against a two-decimal currency and rate outputs at two decimals; other currency precisions and concurrent source edits remain untested.
next: H4b aggregate/compound basis and explicit offsets/withholding/collection, with separate purchase-rule migration when its fixed slots are removed.
